scientific.integrity: The cone coefficients and qualitative root regimes were materially inspected in the 2008 thesis and 2009 primary paper, and the general root classifier was materially inspected in the 2007 full text. The new monotonicity identity is an exact algebraic derivation. Existence of both transitions is certified by rational interval arithmetic; numerical decimals are supplemental only.
limitations: The theorem concerns right circular cones and does not cover oblique or truncated cones.
The transition constants are unique zeros of explicit transcendental functions; no elementary closed form is claimed.
A residual historical risk remains for differently worded or unindexed prior derivations.

title: Complete two-transition Steiner-root phase diagram for right circular cones
